summary: Accept untrusted recall questions over stdin and keep credential-backed HTTP MCP local unless remote callers authenticate with a separate Bearer token.
reason: Shell recipes must not interpolate user questions, and an all-interface MCP listener must not expose the operator's AniList credential to unauthenticated network clients.
validated_outcome: Regression tests preserve shell metacharacters as literal stdin data, require authentication for non-loopback binds, and reject invalid Bearer credentials.
